paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Comparison of trainable parameters between Ex1 and Ex2 in Embedding and LM Head training.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of trainable versus frozen parameters (in percent) for two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, in the context of Embedding and LM Head training. The categories are shown on the vertical axis as two horizontal stacked bars labeled “Ex2” (top) and “Ex1” (bottom), while the horizontal axis represents percentage values (0–100% implied by the stacked totals) on a linear scale, though numeric tick marks and an explicit axis label are not shown. Each experiment is depicted as a two-part stacked bar with a legend indicating dark purple for “Trainable (%)” and light blue for “Frozen (%).” For Ex2, the dark purple trainable segment is labeled 1.29 and is followed by a light blue frozen segment labeled 98.71, forming a full 100% bar. For Ex1, the dark purple trainable segment is labeled 3.41 and is followed by a light blue frozen segment labeled 96.59, also totaling 100%. The bars appear in the order Ex2 then Ex1 (not visibly sorted by value), and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines, annotations beyond the numeric segment labels, or highlighted categories.
